title: 地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證
titleEn: Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
summary: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。
summaryEn: Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」與「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" and "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由段伸長」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-length extension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。試驗伸長比預期小，可能代表自由段黏住或有效長度不足；比預期大則可能包含座頭滑移、鋼材模數差異或錨碇段移動。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由段伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. Less extension than expected may indicate unintended bond or inadequate effective length; excessive movement may include head slip, modulus differences or movement within the bond zone. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-length extension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由段伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-length extension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。試驗伸長比預期小，可能代表自由段黏住或有效長度不足；比預期大則可能包含座頭滑移、鋼材模數差異或錨碇段移動。
knowledge.textEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. Less extension than expected may indicate unintended bond or inadequate effective length; excessive movement may include head slip, modulus differences or movement within the bond zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證」的「自由段伸長的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Free-length extension mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths” in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。
自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。
平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
optionsEn: Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone.
Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
quiz.explanation: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由段伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-length extension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free-length extension mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。
固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。
原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。
optionsEn: A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.
All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由段伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-length extension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。
knowledge.textEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
knowledge.textEn: Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free-length extension mechanism and verification"?
options: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。
optionsEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由段伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-length extension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。
knowledge.textEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。
平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground.
Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
quiz.explanation: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨碇平均剪應力」如何影響地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean bond shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。平均剪應力可作尺度檢查，實際沿長度的分布並不均勻，近端先動員後可能逐步滑移；增加錨碇長度也不保證容量一直線性增加。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨碇平均剪應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. Mean bond shear checks scale, but distribution along the length is nonuniform and may progressively slip after mobilizing near the loaded end. Increasing bond length therefore does not guarantee indefinitely linear capacity growth. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean bond shear” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨碇平均剪應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean bond shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。平均剪應力可作尺度檢查，實際沿長度的分布並不均勻，近端先動員後可能逐步滑移；增加錨碇長度也不保證容量一直線性增加。
knowledge.textEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. Mean bond shear checks scale, but distribution along the length is nonuniform and may progressively slip after mobilizing near the loaded end.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。
試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。
錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。
optionsEn: Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock.
quiz.explanation: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨碇平均剪應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean bond shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。
所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。
鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa.
All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨碇平均剪應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean bond shear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。
knowledge.textEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。
座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability.
Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
quiz.explanation: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean bond shear mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨碇平均剪應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean bond shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。
knowledge.textEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mean bond shear mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。
假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip.
quiz.explanation: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
